dishes.description: Puff pastry cups with melted brie and cranberry sauce. The classic opener.
dishes.name: Cranberry Brie Bites
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and grease a 24-cup mini muffin tin.
Cut the pastry into 24 squares and press one into each cup.
Add a cube of brie and a spoonful of cranberry sauce to each, then sprinkle with pecans.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the pastry is golden, then top with rosemary.

dishes.description: Classic deviled eggs with mustard, mayo, and paprika.
dishes.name: Deviled Eggs
steps: Hard-boil the eggs 12 minutes, cool in ice water, and peel.
Halve lengthwise, scoop the yolks into a bowl, and mash with mayo, mustard, and vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper, pipe or spoon back into the whites.
Chill, then dust with paprika and chives before serving.

dishes.description: Hot, creamy dip with spinach, artichokes, and parmesan. Serve with bread or crackers.

ingredients.item: Frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

dishes.name: Spinach Artichoke Dip
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F.
Stir everything together in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.
Spread into a baking dish and bake 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with sliced baguette or crackers.

dishes.description: Smooth hummus with cucumber, carrots, celery, and bell pepper for dipping.
dishes.name: Hummus and Crudite
steps: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Add water a spoonful at a time until it is dippable, then drizzle with olive oil.
Cut the vegetables into sticks and arrange around the bowl.
Chill until serving; it holds well for hours.

dishes.description: Medjool dates stuffed with goat cheese, wrapped in bacon, baked until crisp.
dishes.name: Bacon-Wrapped Dates
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Stuff each date with a little goat cheese and wrap with half a bacon slice, seam down.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until the bacon is crisp.
Drizzle lightly with honey and serve warm.

dishes.description: Cherry tomatoes, mozzarella pearls, and basil on toothpicks with balsamic glaze.
dishes.name: Caprese Skewers
steps: Thread one tomato, one basil leaf, and one mozzarella pearl onto each skewer.
Arrange on a platter and drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Sprinkle with flaky salt just before serving.

dishes.description: A whole side of salmon with lemon, garlic, and herbs. Feeds a crowd with little fuss.
dishes.name: Herb-Roasted Salmon
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Pat the salmon dry, rub with oil and garlic, and season with salt and pepper.
Top with lemon slices and herbs.
Roast 15 to 20 minutes until it flakes, then rest 5 minutes before serving.

dishes.description: Spiral ham with a brown sugar and honey glaze. Slice at the table.
dishes.name: Honey-Glazed Ham
steps: Heat the oven to 325 F and set the ham in a roasting pan with a little water.
Cover with foil and bake about 12 minutes per pound.
Whisk honey, brown sugar, and mustard, then brush over the ham.
Uncover and bake 20 minutes more, basting once, until glazed.

dishes.description: Bone-in turkey breast with butter, sage, and garlic. All the holiday flavor, half the bird.
dishes.name: Roast Turkey Breast
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F.
Rub the butter, sage, and garlic under and over the skin; season well.
Roast on the onion in a pan, about 20 minutes per pound, until 165 F inside.
Rest 15 minutes before carving.

dishes.description: Hearty lentil chili with tomatoes, beans, and smoky spices. Vegan and filling.
dishes.name: Lentil Chili
steps: Saute the onion and pepper in a little oil until soft.
Add the spices and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add lentils, tomatoes, beans, and broth; simmer 35 to 40 minutes.
Season and serve with toppings on the side.

dishes.description: Layers of pasta, ricotta, spinach, and marinara under melted mozzarella.
dishes.name: Veggie Lasagna
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and cook the noodles until just flexible.
Mix ricotta, egg, spinach, and half the mozzarella.
Layer sauce, noodles, and ricotta mix three times; top with sauce and cheese.
Bake covered 30 minutes, uncovered 15, then rest 10 minutes.

dishes.description: Beef brisket roasted low and slow until it slices tender. Make it the day before.
dishes.name: Slow-Roasted Beef Brisket
steps: Heat the oven to 300 F and season the brisket well.
Sear it in a Dutch oven, then add onions, broth, and tomato paste.
Cover and roast about 4 hours until very tender.
Rest 20 minutes, slice against the grain, and spoon the juices over.

dishes.description: Crispy-edged sprouts with olive oil, garlic, and a balsamic finish.
dishes.name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Toss the sprouts with oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Roast cut-side down 20 to 25 minutes until crisp, then drizzle with balsamic.

dishes.description: Tender carrots in a brown sugar and butter glaze.
dishes.name: Glazed Carrots
steps: Simmer the carrots in salted water 8 minutes, then drain.
Melt butter with brown sugar in the same pan.
Toss the carrots in the glaze 3 minutes until shiny, then top with parsley.

dishes.description: Green beans in creamy mushroom sauce under crispy fried onions.
dishes.name: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F and blanch the beans 5 minutes.
Stir soup, milk, soy sauce, and half the onions with the beans.
Bake 25 minutes, top with the rest of the onions, and bake 5 minutes more.

dishes.description: Charred broccoli florets with lemon and parmesan.
dishes.name: Roasted Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Toss the broccoli with oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes, then finish with lemon zest and parmesan.

dishes.description: Mashed sweet potatoes with butter and a little maple.
dishes.name: Sweet Potato Mash
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes until very tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain and mash with butter, maple, and cinnamon.
Season with salt and serve warm.

dishes.description: Creamy, spoonable corn bake with a golden top.
dishes.name: Corn Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a baking dish.
Stir everything together and pour into the dish.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes until set and golden at the edges.

dishes.description: Buttery bread stuffing with celery, onion, and sage.
dishes.name: Classic Stuffing
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a baking dish.
Cook onion and celery in butter until soft, then stir in the herbs.
Toss with the bread cubes and broth until moist, then bake 35 to 40 minutes.

dishes.description: Stovetop macaroni in a sharp cheddar sauce, baked with a crumb top.
dishes.name: Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook the macaroni and heat the oven to 375 F.
Make a roux with butter and flour, whisk in milk, then melt in the cheese.
Combine with the pasta, top with crumbs, and bake 25 to 30 minutes.

dishes.description: Thin-sliced potatoes baked in a creamy garlic sauce.
dishes.name: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and grease a baking dish.
Layer potatoes with cream, garlic, and cheese, seasoning as you go.
Cover and bake 45 minutes, uncover and bake 15 more until golden.

dishes.description: Fluffy mashed potatoes with butter and warm milk.
dishes.name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain well and return to the hot pot to dry for a minute.
Mash with butter and warm milk until smooth.

dishes.description: Soft, buttery rolls baked golden. Best warm.
dishes.name: Dinner Rolls
steps: Mix yeast with warm milk and sugar; rest 5 minutes until foamy.
Knead in flour and butter, then rise 1 hour until doubled.
Shape into 12 rolls, rise 30 minutes, and bake at 375 F for 18 to 20 minutes.

dishes.description: Whole-berry sauce with orange zest. Made ahead, served cold.
dishes.name: Cranberry Sauce
steps: Simmer sugar and water until the sugar dissolves.
Add cranberries and cook 10 minutes until most have popped.
Stir in the zest, cool, and chill. It thickens as it sets.

dishes.description: Creamy cheesecake with a pecan praline topping.
dishes.name: Pecan Cheesecake
steps: Heat the oven to 325 F and press the crumbs with butter into a springform pan.
Beat cream cheese and sugar, add eggs one at a time, and pour over the crust.
Bake about 1 hour until just set in the center, then cool and chill.
Top with the pecan praline before serving.

dishes.description: Spiced pumpkin custard in a flaky crust with whipped cream.
dishes.name: Pumpkin Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and fit the crust into a pie dish.
Whisk pumpkin, condensed milk, eggs, and spice until smooth.
Pour in and bake 15 minutes, then lower to 350 F and bake 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool completely before slicing.

dishes.description: Warm spiced apples under a buttery oat crumble.
dishes.name: Apple Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and toss the apples with half the sugar and the cinnamon.
Rub oats, flour, remaining sugar, and butter into crumbs.
Spread the apples in a dish, top with the crumble, and bake 35 to 40 minutes.

dishes.description: Dense, fudgy brownies with a crackly top.
dishes.name: Chocolate Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F and line an 8-inch pan with parchment.
Melt butter, stir in sugar and cocoa, then beat in the eggs.
Fold in the flour just until combined and bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Cool before cutting so they hold their shape.

dishes.description: Bright lemon bars on a shortbread base, dusted with sugar.
dishes.name: Lemon Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F and press a shortbread base of flour, butter, and sugar into a pan.
Bake the base 15 minutes.
Whisk eggs, sugar, lemon juice, and flour; pour over the hot base and bake 20 minutes more.
Cool, chill, and dust with powdered sugar.

dishes.description: Fresh berries, melon, and grapes with mint and lime.
dishes.name: Fruit Salad
steps: Cut the fruit into bite-size pieces and combine in a large bowl.
Toss with lime juice and torn mint.
Chill until serving; add delicate berries last so they hold up.

dishes.description: Chilled sparkling apple cider, served in a punch bowl or straight from the bottle.
dishes.name: Sparkling Cider
steps: Chill the cider well ahead of time.
Pour into a punch bowl with apple slices and cinnamon sticks.
Serve cold.

dishes.description: A self-serve seltzer bar with citrus, cucumber, and mint.
dishes.name: Seltzer Bar
steps: Chill the seltzer and set the cans in a cooler with ice.
Arrange citrus, cucumber, and mint in small bowls beside it.
Guests mix their own; refill the garnishes as needed.

dishes.description: Warm apple cider simmered with cinnamon, cloves, and orange.
dishes.name: Mulled Cider
steps: Combine everything in a pot or slow cooker.
Simmer gently 30 minutes; do not boil hard.
Keep warm on low and ladle into mugs.

dishes.description: Fresh lemonade, tart and not too sweet.
dishes.name: Lemonade
steps: Dissolve the sugar in 1 cup of warm water.
Stir in the lemon juice and remaining cold water.
Chill, pour over ice, and adjust sweetness to taste.

dishes.description: Brewed black tea, lightly sweet, served over ice with lemon.
dishes.name: Iced Tea
steps: Steep the tea bags in boiling water 5 minutes, then remove them.
Stir in the sugar while warm, then cool and chill.
Serve over ice with lemon slices.

dishes.description: A hot cocoa bar with milk, cocoa, marshmallows, and toppings.
dishes.name: Hot Cocoa Bar
steps: Warm the milk in a pot or slow cooker; do not boil.
Whisk in cocoa and sugar until smooth.
Set out marshmallows and whipped cream and let guests top their own.

dishes.description: Charred corn on the cob with mayo, cotija, chili, and lime.
dishes.name: Elote
steps: Grill or broil the corn until charred in spots, about 10 minutes.
Brush each ear with mayo and roll in cotija.
Dust with chili powder and serve with lime wedges.

dishes.description: Shredded chicken in smoky chipotle-tomato sauce, served in warm tortillas.
dishes.name: Chicken Tinga Tacos
steps: Simmer the chicken in salted water until tender, then shred it.
Blend tomatoes and chipotles, then simmer with the onion until thick.
Stir in the chicken, season, and serve in warm tortillas with toppings.

dishes.description: Stir-fried beef with onions, tomatoes, and fries, served over rice.
dishes.name: Lomo Saltado
steps: Sear the beef in a very hot pan in batches; set aside.
Stir-fry the onion and tomato 2 minutes, then add soy sauce.
Return the beef, toss with the hot fries, and serve over rice.

dishes.description: Chilled layered potato cake with lime, chicken salad, and avocado.
dishes.name: Causa Limena
steps: Mash the warm potatoes with lime juice and a little oil; season well.
Mix the chicken with mayo.
Layer potato, chicken, and avocado in a dish, chill, and slice to serve.

dishes.description: Chewy cheese breads made with tapioca flour. Naturally gluten-free.
dishes.name: Pao de Queijo
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F and grease a mini muffin tin.
Warm milk and oil, pour over the tapioca flour, and stir.
Mix in cheese and egg, scoop into the tin, and bake 15 to 20 minutes.

dishes.description: Slow-cooked black bean stew with pork and sausage, served with rice and oranges.
dishes.name: Feijoada
steps: Brown the pork and sausage, then add onion and garlic.
Add beans, bay leaves, and water to cover; simmer about 2 hours.
Season and serve over rice with orange slices.

dishes.description: Chicken marinated in scotch bonnet, allspice, and thyme, grilled until charred.
dishes.name: Jerk Chicken
steps: Blend the pepper, allspice, thyme, green onions, and lime into a paste.
Rub over the chicken and marinate at least 2 hours, overnight if possible.
Grill over medium heat 25 to 30 minutes, turning, until cooked through.

dishes.description: Sweet ripe plantains fried until caramelized at the edges.
dishes.name: Maduros
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Fry the plantain slices 2 to 3 minutes per side until deep golden.
Drain, sprinkle with salt, and serve warm.

dishes.description: Crisp risotto balls stuffed with mozzarella, rolled in breadcrumbs.
dishes.name: Arancini
steps: Shape the cold risotto around a cube of mozzarella.
Roll each ball in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs.
Bake at 400 F for 20 to 25 minutes, or fry until golden.

dishes.description: Coffee-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream and cocoa.
dishes.name: Tiramisu
steps: Whisk yolks with sugar, fold in mascarpone, then fold in whipped whites.
Dip ladyfingers quickly in coffee and layer with the cream twice.
Chill at least 4 hours, then dust with cocoa before serving.

dishes.description: Crispy fried potatoes with a smoky tomato sauce and garlicky aioli.
dishes.name: Patatas Bravas
steps: Fry the potatoes in hot oil until crisp, about 10 minutes.
Simmer tomatoes with paprika into a thick sauce.
Top the potatoes with the sauce and a spoonful of garlic mayo.

dishes.description: Saffron rice with chicken, sausage, shrimp, and peppers, cooked in one wide pan.
dishes.name: Paella
steps: Brown the chicken and chorizo in a wide pan, then add peppers and rice.
Add saffron broth and simmer 20 minutes without stirring.
Nestle in the shrimp, cook 8 minutes more, and rest 5 minutes.

dishes.description: Slow-cooked eggplant, zucchini, peppers, and tomato with herbs.
dishes.name: Ratatouille
steps: Salt the eggplant 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Saute each vegetable in olive oil until softened.
Combine with tomatoes and herbs, simmer 30 minutes, and serve warm or room temperature.

dishes.description: Airy dark chocolate mousse, chilled and served in small cups.
dishes.name: Chocolate Mousse
steps: Melt the chocolate and let it cool slightly.
Whisk in the yolks, then fold in the whipped cream and stiff egg whites.
Chill at least 3 hours before serving.

dishes.description: Flaky phyllo triangles filled with spinach and feta.
dishes.name: Spanakopita
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and mix spinach, feta, dill, and green onions.
Cut phyllo into strips, brush with butter, and fold the filling into triangles.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden and crisp.

dishes.description: Tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and feta with olive oil and oregano.
dishes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and olives in a wide bowl.
Lay the feta on top and drizzle generously with olive oil.
Season with oregano and salt just before serving.

dishes.description: Potato and cheese dumplings, boiled and pan-fried with onions.
dishes.name: Pierogi
steps: Mix the mashed potatoes with cheese and season well.
Fill each wrapper, seal the edges, and boil until they float.
Pan-fry in butter with onions until golden; serve with sour cream.

dishes.description: Earthy beet soup with cabbage and dill, served with sour cream.
dishes.name: Borscht
steps: Saute onion and carrots, then add beets, cabbage, and broth.
Simmer 40 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Season with vinegar and serve with sour cream and dill.

dishes.description: Small beef and pork meatballs in a creamy gravy, with lingonberry on the side.
dishes.name: Swedish Meatballs
steps: Mix the meat with breadcrumbs, milk, onion, and seasoning; roll into small balls.
Brown in butter, then set aside.
Make a gravy from the drippings, broth, and cream; simmer the meatballs in it 10 minutes.

dishes.description: Warm potato salad with bacon, vinegar, and mustard. No mayo.
dishes.name: German Potato Salad
steps: Cook the bacon until crisp; set the bacon aside and keep the drippings.
Whisk vinegar, mustard, and a little sugar into the warm drippings.
Toss with the warm potatoes, bacon, and green onions; serve warm.

dishes.description: Seasoned lamb under a mashed potato crust, baked golden.
dishes.name: Shepherds Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and brown the lamb with onion and carrot.
Stir in tomato paste and broth; simmer 10 minutes.
Spread the lamb in a dish, top with mashed potatoes, and bake 30 minutes.

dishes.description: Rustic soda bread with a crisp crust and soft crumb.
dishes.name: Soda Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Mix flour, soda, and salt; stir in buttermilk until a shaggy dough forms.
Shape into a round, score a cross, and bake 30 to 35 minutes.

dishes.description: Crispy potato pancakes with applesauce and sour cream.
dishes.name: Latkes
steps: Squeeze the grated potato and onion very dry.
Mix with eggs, flour, and salt.
Fry spoonfuls in hot oil 3 to 4 minutes per side until crisp; serve with applesauce.

dishes.description: Braided egg bread, soft inside and glossy on top.
dishes.name: Challah
steps: Mix yeast with warm water and honey; rest until foamy.
Knead in flour, eggs, and oil; rise 1 hour.
Braid into a loaf, rise 30 minutes, brush with egg, and bake at 350 F for 30 minutes.

dishes.description: Crisp chickpea fritters with herbs, served with tahini sauce.
dishes.name: Falafel
steps: Pulse the soaked chickpeas with onion, garlic, herbs, and spices; do not over-process.
Shape into small patties and rest 15 minutes.
Fry in hot oil 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden.

dishes.description: Parsley, tomato, and bulgur salad with lemon and olive oil.
dishes.name: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak the bulgur in hot water 10 minutes, then drain.
Combine with parsley, tomato, and green onion.
Dress with lemon juice and olive oil just before serving.

dishes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce. Serve with bread.
dishes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Saute onion and peppers, add spices, then tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 7 to 9 minutes until the whites set; serve with bread.

dishes.description: Shredded carrots with cumin, lemon, and a little honey.
dishes.name: Moroccan Carrot Salad
steps: Grate the carrots into a large bowl.
Whisk lemon juice, oil, cumin, and honey into a dressing.
Toss and chill at least 30 minutes before serving.

dishes.description: Smoky tomato rice, the West African party staple.
dishes.name: Jollof Rice
steps: Blend tomatoes, onion, and pepper into a sauce; fry it with tomato paste until dark.
Add broth and rice, cover, and cook on low 30 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes, fluff, and serve.

dishes.description: Rich peanut stew with chicken and sweet potato, served over rice.
dishes.name: Groundnut Stew
steps: Brown the chicken, then saute onion and ginger.
Stir in peanut butter, tomatoes, and broth until smooth.
Add sweet potato and simmer 30 minutes; serve over rice.

dishes.description: Spiced red lentils in berbere sauce, the vegan centerpiece of an Ethiopian table.
dishes.name: Misir Wat
steps: Cook the onion in oil over low heat until very soft, about 10 minutes.
Add berbere, garlic, and ginger; cook 2 minutes.
Add lentils and water; simmer 30 minutes until thick and soft.

dishes.description: Spongy teff flatbread, the base for scooping stews.
dishes.name: Injera
steps: Whisk teff flour with water into a thin batter; rest at least 30 minutes.
Pour a thin round into a hot, lightly oiled pan and cover.
Cook until bubbles set the top, about 2 minutes; do not flip.

dishes.description: Crisp pastry triangles filled with spiced potatoes and peas.
dishes.name: Samosas
steps: Season the potatoes and peas with the spices.
Fill each wrapper, seal the edges with water, and fold into triangles.
Bake at 400 F for 18 to 20 minutes, or fry until golden.

dishes.description: Chickpeas simmered in a spiced tomato sauce. Hearty and vegan.
dishes.name: Chana Masala
steps: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger until soft.
Add spices and tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 15 minutes and serve with rice.

dishes.description: Rice noodles with egg, shrimp, peanuts, and tamarind.
dishes.name: Pad Thai
steps: Stir-fry the shrimp in a hot wok; set aside.
Scramble the eggs, add the noodles and sauce, and toss until soft.
Return the shrimp, top with peanuts and lime, and serve at once.

dishes.description: Warm sticky rice with ripe mango and sweet coconut milk.
dishes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Steam the soaked rice 20 to 25 minutes until tender.
Warm the coconut milk with sugar and pour half over the rice; rest 10 minutes.
Serve with mango slices and the remaining coconut milk.

dishes.description: Fresh rice paper rolls with shrimp, herbs, and peanut sauce.
dishes.name: Goi Cuon
steps: Soak one rice paper at a time until pliable.
Layer shrimp, noodles, and herbs, then roll tightly.
Serve with peanut sauce; keep covered so they do not dry out.

dishes.description: Fragrant chicken noodle soup with ginger, star anise, and fresh herbs.
dishes.name: Pho Ga
steps: Simmer the chicken with charred ginger and onion and the spices for 45 minutes.
Shred the chicken and strain the broth; season with fish sauce.
Serve over noodles with herbs, bean sprouts, and lime.

dishes.description: Crisp pork and shrimp spring rolls with sweet chili sauce.
dishes.name: Lumpia
steps: Mix pork, shrimp, and vegetables; season with soy sauce and garlic.
Roll tightly in wrappers and seal the edges with water.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp; serve with sweet chili sauce.

dishes.description: Chicken braised in soy, vinegar, and garlic until the sauce turns to glaze.
dishes.name: Chicken Adobo
steps: Combine chicken, soy, vinegar, garlic, and bay in a pot; rest 15 minutes.
Simmer covered 30 minutes, turning once.
Uncover and reduce the sauce to a glaze; serve over rice.

dishes.description: Beef slow-braised in coconut milk and spices until dark and tender.
dishes.name: Rendang
steps: Simmer the beef with coconut milk, spice paste, and aromatics.
Cook on low 2 to 3 hours, stirring now and then, until the sauce darkens and the beef is tender.
Rest before serving with rice.

dishes.description: Blanched vegetables and tofu with a warm peanut sauce.
dishes.name: Gado-Gado
steps: Blanch the vegetables until just tender and cool them.
Arrange vegetables, tofu, and egg on a platter.
Pour warm peanut sauce over and top with crackers.

dishes.description: Pork and cabbage dumplings, pan-fried crisp on one side and steamed.
dishes.name: Dumplings
steps: Mix pork, cabbage, and seasonings into a filling.
Fill and pleat each wrapper, sealing the edges.
Pan-fry until the bottoms are golden, add water, cover, and steam 6 minutes.

dishes.description: Silken tofu in a spicy Sichuan pepper sauce. Bold and fast.
dishes.name: Mapo Tofu
steps: Brown the pork, then add chili bean paste and peppercorns.
Add a splash of broth and gently slide in the tofu.
Simmer 5 minutes, top with green onions, and serve over rice.

dishes.description: Simple miso soup with tofu, wakame, and green onion.
dishes.name: Miso Soup
steps: Warm the dashi and soak the wakame.
Whisk in the miso off the boil so it keeps its flavor.
Add tofu and green onions and serve at once.

dishes.description: Crispy panko chicken cutlets with tonkatsu sauce and shredded cabbage.
dishes.name: Chicken Katsu
steps: Coat the chicken in flour, egg, then panko.
Fry in hot oil 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden.
Rest, slice, and serve with tonkatsu sauce and cabbage.

dishes.description: Warm rice bowls with seasoned vegetables, egg, and gochujang.
dishes.name: Bibimbap
steps: Season and saute each vegetable separately.
Cook the beef with soy, sesame, and garlic.
Assemble bowls of rice topped with vegetables, beef, and a fried egg; serve with gochujang.

dishes.description: Fermented napa cabbage with chili, garlic, and ginger. Make it days ahead.
dishes.name: Kimchi
steps: Salt the cabbage 2 hours, then rinse and drain well.
Mix the chili paste with garlic, ginger, fish sauce, and green onions.
Coat the cabbage, pack into a jar, and ferment 2 to 3 days before chilling.

dishes.description: Chicken quarters marinated in lemongrass, garlic, and fish sauce, then roasted until the skin crisps. Bright, savory, and built for a crowd.
dishes.name: Lemongrass Chicken
steps: Stir the lemongrass, garlic, ginger, fish sauce, vinegar, oil, lime juice, and pepper into a paste.
Rub the paste all over the chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 425 F and arrange the chicken skin side up on a sheet pan.
Roast 35 to 40 minutes, until the thickest piece reads 165 F.

dishes.description: A 15 minute bowl of lemongrass turkey over vermicelli with pickled carrots, cucumber, bean sprouts, and herbs. All the banh mi flavors without the sandwich press.
dishes.name: Turkey Banh Mi Bowl
steps: Cook the vermicelli, drain, and divide among bowls.
Saute the turkey in a hot skillet, breaking it up, then stir in the lemongrass, garlic, ginger, and pepper.
Finish with the fish sauce and cook until the edges crisp a little.
Top the noodles with turkey, pickled carrots, cucumber, sprouts, and herbs, with lime on the side.

dishes.description: Carrots and onion in a rice vinegar brine, sharp and crunchy. The side that cuts through rich mains.
dishes.name: Quick-Pickled Carrots and Onions
steps: Warm the vinegar, water, sugar, and salt until the sugar dissolves.
Pour over the carrots and onion in a jar or bowl.
Chill at least 1 hour; the flavor improves overnight.

dishes.description: Baked rigatoni with beef, spinach, and red sauce under a mozzarella top. Our upgraded version swaps half the beef for cooked lentils and adds grated carrot and diced mushrooms.

ingredients.item: Frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

dishes.name: Beef and Spinach Baked Rigatoni
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and boil the rigatoni until just shy of done.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic, then stir in the spinach and sauce.
Fold in the pasta, top with mozzarella, and bake about 20 minutes until bubbling.

dishes.description: Rigatoni in a sauce of rendered pancetta and cherry tomatoes collapsed in the pan, with peas tossed in at the end and pecorino on top.
dishes.name: Pancetta and Cherry Tomato Rigatoni
steps: Boil the rigatoni in salted water and save a cup of the pasta water.
Render the pancetta until crisp, then add the garlic and tomatoes.
Cook until the tomatoes collapse into a sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Toss in the pasta and peas, warm through, and finish with basil and pecorino.

dishes.description: Bone-in thighs seared and braised in fire-roasted tomatoes with balsamic, finished with ricotta and basil. One pan, deep flavor.
dishes.name: Fire-Roasted Tomato Braised Chicken Thighs
steps: Sear the thighs skin side down in the oil until the skin is crisp; set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan, then add the tomatoes and balsamic.
Nestle the thighs back in and braise 30 to 35 minutes, until tender.
Finish with dollops of ricotta and torn basil.

dishes.description: A sturdy egg bake with potato and mixed vegetables. Good warm or at room temperature, which makes it potluck friendly.
dishes.name: Potato and Vegetable Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and cook the potatoes in oil in an oven-safe skillet until tender.
Add the vegetables until soft, then pour in the beaten eggs with the parmesan.
Cook on the stove until the edges set, then bake 12 to 15 minutes until the center is just set.

dishes.description: All the comfort of the classic, with blended potato giving the body instead of cream. The cheddar goes in off the heat so it stays smooth.
dishes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup (No Cream)
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the potato and broth and simmer until tender.
Add the broccoli and cook until just bright green.
Blend part of the soup until smooth and stir it back in.
Off the heat, melt in the cheddar a handful at a time.

dishes.description: Chicken thighs, potatoes, and broccoli roasted together on one pan. Weeknight simple, and it scales to feed a table.
dishes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Potatoes and Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and toss the potatoes with the oil and spices on a sheet pan.
Add the thighs skin side up and roast 20 minutes.
Scatter the broccoli around the chicken and roast 12 to 15 minutes more, until the thighs read 165 F.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with the lemon wedges.

dishes.description: Smoky black bean chili ladled over baked potatoes, skins and all. Fully vegan and filling enough to anchor the table.

ingredients.item: Chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika

dishes.name: Black Bean Chili over Baked Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F and bake the potatoes until tender, about 45 minutes.
Soften the onion and peppers in the oil, then add the spices, beans, and tomatoes.
Simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Split the potatoes and ladle the chili over the top.

dishes.description: Kidney beans with tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion in a lemon oregano dressing, with feta crumbled over the top. Bright next to rich mains.
dishes.name: Lemon-Herb Kidney Bean Salad
steps: Whisk the lemon juice, oil, and oregano with salt and pepper.
Toss the beans, tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and parsley with the dressing.
Chill at least 30 minutes, then top with the feta.

dishes.description: Kidney beans and corn with bell pepper, smoked paprika, and lime. A sturdy, scoopable side that holds up on a buffet.
dishes.name: Smoky Kidney Bean and Corn Succotash
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil.
Add the beans, corn, paprika, and cumin and cook until heated through and a little charred at the edges.
Finish with the lime juice and cilantro.

dishes.description: Chilled rice stir-fried with chicken, egg, peas, and carrots in soy and sesame. The most reliable way to empty the rice cooker.
dishes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in the oil and set aside.
Sear the chicken, then add the peas and carrots.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and fry until hot and a little crisp.
Season with soy and sesame oil, and fold the egg and green onions back in.

dishes.description: The same fried rice base as the chicken version, minus the chicken and loaded with vegetables. A vegetarian staple that eats like a main.
dishes.name: Vegetable Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in the oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the pepper, peas, and carrots until tender.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and fry until hot and a little crisp.
Season with soy and sesame oil, and fold the egg and green onions back in.

dishes.description: Shredded chicken thighs and mixed vegetables in a savory broth with springy ramen noodles. Cozy and quick.
dishes.name: Chicken Thigh Ramen
steps: Simmer the thighs in the broth with the ginger and garlic until tender, then shred the meat.
Return the chicken to the broth with the vegetables and soy sauce.
Add the noodles and cook until just springy.
Serve topped with green onions.

dishes.description: Flaky rockfish in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw, avocado, and lime crema, with rice on the side. A lighter taco that still feeds a crowd.
dishes.name: Rockfish Tacos
steps: Season the rockfish with the spices and sear until it flakes.
Stir lime juice and zest into the sour cream to make the crema.
Char the tortillas and build tacos with fish, slaw, and avocado.
Serve with the rice, cilantro, and extra lime.

dishes.description: Thai wheat noodles and crisped tofu tossed with spinach in a soy, sesame, and peanut sauce. Vegan, and the spinach wilts right into the noodles.
dishes.name: Tofu Thai Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Press and cube the tofu, then sear until golden.
Boil the noodles and save a splash of the cooking water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, sesame oil, lime, and garlic into a sauce, loosened with noodle water.
Toss the noodles, tofu, and spinach in the sauce until the spinach wilts.

dishes.description: Chewy sweet potato glass noodles tossed with vegetables in a sesame soy sauce. A festive Korean staple that works warm or at room temperature.
dishes.name: Japchae
steps: Boil the noodles until chewy-tender, drain, and snip into shorter lengths.
Stir-fry the vegetables separately until just tender, wilting the spinach last.
Toss everything with the soy, sesame oil, sugar, and garlic.
Serve warm or at room temperature, sprinkled with sesame seeds.

dishes.description: Chewy rice cakes simmered in a sweet and spicy gochujang sauce. Street food heat that disappears fast.
dishes.name: Tteokbokki
steps: Simmer the water with the gochujang, soy, sugar, and garlic into a sauce.
Add the rice cakes and cook, stirring, until they are soft and chewy and the sauce thickens.
Finish with green onions and sesame seeds.

dishes.description: Pan-fried yeast pancakes with a molten brown sugar, cinnamon, and nut filling. Best eaten warm, with caution and enthusiasm.
dishes.name: Hoddeok
steps: Make a soft dough with the flour, yeast, milk, and sugar and let it rise 1 hour.
Divide into balls, fill each with the brown sugar, cinnamon, and nuts, and pinch closed.
Pan-fry in oil, pressing flat, until both sides are golden and the filling melts.

dishes.description: Hand-pressed rice triangles filled with tuna mayo and wrapped in nori. Portable, tidy, and easy to eat standing up.
dishes.name: Onigiri
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool until you can handle it.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise and soy sauce.
With wet, salted hands, press rice around a spoonful of filling into triangles.
Wrap each with nori and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

dishes.description: Eggplant roasted until silky and lacquered with a sweet white miso glaze. The dengaku classic.
dishes.name: Miso-Glazed Eggplant
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F, score the eggplant flesh, and brush with oil.
Roast until completely tender, about 15 minutes.
Whisk the miso, mirin, sugar, and water, spread over the tops, and broil or bake 3 more minutes until glossy.
Finish with sesame seeds and green onions.

dishes.description: Flaky, layered pancakes rolled with scallions and pan-fried until crisp at the edges. Tear, do not cut.
dishes.name: Scallion Pancakes
steps: Knead the flour and hot water into a dough and rest 30 minutes.
Roll out, brush with sesame oil, scatter scallions and salt, roll up, coil, and roll flat again.
Pan-fry in oil until golden and flaky on both sides.

dishes.description: Wheat noodles in a chili crisp and peanut sauce with seasoned pork and bok choy. Numbing, spicy, and rich.
dishes.name: Dan Dan Noodles
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, chili crisp, soy, vinegar, peppercorns, and sesame oil with hot noodle water into a sauce.
Brown the pork with the garlic until crisp at the edges.
Boil the noodles and bok choy, then toss everything in the sauce.
Top with chopped peanuts.

dishes.description: Cucumbers smashed so they drink up a garlicky rice vinegar and sesame dressing. Cold, crunchy, and refreshing.
dishes.name: Smashed Cucumber Salad
steps: Smash the cucumbers with the side of a knife, tear into chunks, and salt for 10 minutes.
Drain and toss with the garlic, vinegar, soy, sesame oil, sugar, and chili crisp.
Chill and top with cilantro.

dishes.description: Chicken simmered in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce, served over basmati rice. The crowd-pleasing curry.
dishes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt and half the garam masala for at least 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken, then set aside.
Simmer the tomato, ginger, garlic, and remaining spices in butter, stir in the cream, and return the chicken.
Simmer until tender and serve over the rice.

dishes.description: Cool yogurt with cucumber, cumin, and mint. The spoonful that saves you from the spicy dishes.
dishes.name: Raita
steps: Stir the yogurt with the cumin and salt until smooth.
Fold in the cucumber and mint.
Chill at least 30 minutes before serving.

dishes.description: Soft milk dumplings fried golden and soaked in cardamom rose syrup. Serve warm if you can.
dishes.name: Gulab Jamun
steps: Simmer the sugar, water, and cardamom into a syrup and finish with rose water.
Mix the milk powder, flour, soda, butter, and milk into a soft dough and roll into small balls.
Fry gently until deep golden.
Soak the warm dumplings in the warm syrup for at least 30 minutes.

dishes.description: Mango, yogurt, and cardamom blended thick and cold. Dessert and drink in one glass.
dishes.name: Mango Lassi
steps: Blend everything until completely smooth.
Taste and adjust the sugar to the mangoes.
Serve very cold.

dishes.description: Green papaya salad pounded with lime, fish sauce, peanuts, and chilies. Sour, salty, sweet, and hot at once.
dishes.name: Som Tam
steps: Pound the garlic and chilies, then stir in the lime, fish sauce, and sugar.
Add the papaya, carrots, and beans and bruise lightly with the pestle or a spoon.
Fold in the tomatoes and peanuts and serve right away.

dishes.description: Minced chicken tossed warm with lime, fish sauce, toasted rice powder, and a pile of mint. Scoop it up with lettuce.
dishes.name: Larb Gai
steps: Cook the chicken in a dry pan with a splash of water until just done.
Off the heat, season with lime, fish sauce, and the rice powder.
Fold in the shallots, herbs, and chilies.
Serve with the lettuce leaves for wrapping.

dishes.description: Strong spiced tea sweetened and poured over ice with a float of half-and-half. Sunset orange and very cold.

ingredients.item: Thai tea leaves or strong black tea

dishes.name: Thai Iced Tea
steps: Steep the tea in hot water for 5 minutes and strain.
Stir in the sugar while warm, then chill.
Pour over ice and top each glass with half-and-half.

dishes.description: The three color dessert: sweet red beans, mung bean, and grass jelly layered with coconut milk over crushed ice. A dessert and a drink in one cup.
dishes.name: Che Ba Mau
steps: Sweeten the mung beans and red beans with a little of the sugar and chill.
Sweeten the coconut milk with the remaining sugar.
Layer beans, mung bean, and jelly in glasses, top with crushed ice, and pour the coconut milk over.

dishes.description: Strong coffee poured over ice with sweetened condensed milk. Stir it up and drink it cold and sweet.
dishes.name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee
steps: Stir the condensed milk into the hot coffee until dissolved.
Pour over glasses full of ice.
Serve with a spoon for stirring.

dishes.description: Rice noodles stir-fried with chicken, cabbage, carrots, and green beans in soy, with lemon squeezed over at the table. Built for gatherings.
dishes.name: Pancit Bihon
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil, then add the broth and soy and bring to a simmer.
Add the noodles and cook, tossing, until they drink up the broth.
Fold in the chicken and vegetables and cook until just tender.
Serve with lemon wedges.

dishes.description: A soft coconut rice cake with salted egg, baked until the edges caramelize. A Filipino holiday classic that works any time.
dishes.name: Bibingka
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and line a baking pan.
Whisk the rice flour, coconut milk, sugar, eggs, baking powder, and butter into a batter.
Pour into the pan, top with salted egg, and bake about 30 minutes until set and golden at the edges.
Scatter the coconut over the top and serve warm.

dishes.description: Calamansi, water, and sugar stirred into a sharp, floral cooler. Lime juice works if calamansi is out of season.
dishes.name: Calamansi Juice
steps: Stir the calamansi juice, water, and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Chill well.
Serve over plenty of ice.

dishes.description: Grilled turmeric chicken skewers with a warm peanut sauce for dunking. Make extra sauce; it goes on everything.
dishes.name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
steps: Marinate the chicken in the coconut milk, soy, turmeric, and garlic for at least 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or broil until charred at the edges.
Warm the peanut butter with coconut milk from the marinade bowl, lime, and sugar into a sauce.
Serve the skewers with the sauce on the side.

dishes.description: Indonesian fried rice darkened with kecap manis, with chicken, egg, and peas, and cucumber on the side. Deeper and sweeter than other fried rices.
dishes.name: Nasi Goreng
steps: Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Sear the chicken with the shallots and garlic.
Add the rice and fry until hot, then season with kecap manis and soy until the rice turns glossy and dark.
Fold in the peas and eggs and serve with cucumber.

dishes.description: Sheet pan chicken thighs in shawarma spices, sliced thin and piled into pita with lettuce and tomato. All the flavor of the spit, none of the spit.
dishes.name: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, oil, spices, garlic, and lemon for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425 F and roast the thighs on a sheet pan until charred at the edges, about 25 minutes.
Rest, slice thin, and pile into warm pitas with lettuce and tomato.

dishes.description: Crisp phyllo layered with walnuts and pistachios, soaked in honey lemon syrup. Sticky, rich, and cut small on purpose.
dishes.name: Baklava
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F and layer phyllo in a pan, brushing each sheet with butter and scattering nuts every few layers.
Cut into diamonds before baking.
Bake about 35 minutes until deep golden.
Pour the warm honey, sugar, and lemon syrup over the hot pastry and let it soak at least 2 hours.

dishes.description: Thick yogurt with cucumber, garlic, lemon, and dill, with warm pita for scooping. Cool and garlicky.
dishes.name: Tzatziki with Pita
steps: Stir the yogurt with the garlic, lemon, oil, and dill.
Fold in the squeezed cucumber and salt to taste.
Chill at least 1 hour and serve with warm pita.

dishes.description: Layers of eggplant and spiced lamb under a thick bechamel top, baked until it holds a slice. Greek comfort food at its best.
dishes.name: Moussaka
steps: Salt and roast or pan-fry the eggplant slices until soft.
Brown the lamb with onion and garlic, then simmer with the tomato sauce and cinnamon.
Whisk the flour and butter, add the milk into a thick bechamel, and stir in the cheese and yolks off the heat.
Layer eggplant and meat in a dish, top with bechamel, and bake at 375 F for about 35 minutes until golden. Rest before slicing.

dishes.description: Avocados mashed chunky with lime, onion, cilantro, and jalapeno, with a big bag of chips. Make it at the last minute and make a lot.
dishes.name: Guacamole and Chips
steps: Mash the avocados with the lime and salt, keeping it chunky.
Fold in the onion, cilantro, and jalapeno.
Serve right away with the chips.

dishes.description: Pork and hominy in a deep red chile broth, with cabbage, radish, and lime piled on at the table. A celebratory soup that feeds a crowd.
dishes.name: Pozole Rojo
steps: Simmer the pork in the broth until tender, about 45 minutes, skimming as needed.
Soak the chiles in hot water, blend with garlic and onion, and strain into the pot.
Add the hominy and oregano and simmer 15 minutes more.
Serve with cabbage, radish, and lime on the side.

dishes.description: A light sponge soaked in three milks and topped with whipped cream and cinnamon. It must be made ahead, which is a gift.
dishes.name: Tres Leches Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F and bake the sponge in a 9x13 pan for about 30 minutes.
Whisk the three milks with the vanilla and pour slowly over the warm cake.
Chill at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with whipped cream and cinnamon before serving.

dishes.description: Hibiscus flowers steeped into a tart, ruby red cooler with lime. The color alone earns its place on the table.
dishes.name: Agua Fresca de Jamaica
steps: Steep the hibiscus in hot water for 10 minutes and strain.
Stir in the sugar while warm, then add the lime.
Chill and serve over ice.

dishes.description: The Spanish potato and onion omelette, cooked low in olive oil and sliced into wedges. Equally good warm, cold, or the next day.
dishes.name: Tortilla Espanola
steps: Cook the potatoes and onion slowly in the oil until completely tender; drain, saving the oil.
Fold the potato mixture into the beaten eggs with the salt and rest 10 minutes.
Cook in a skillet in a little of the saved oil until set at the edges, flip, and finish until just set in the middle.

dishes.description: Tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, and stale bread blended with sherry vinegar and olive oil, served ice cold. Summer in a bowl.
dishes.name: Gazpacho
steps: Blend everything except the oil until smooth.
With the blender running, stream in the oil until glossy.
Chill at least 2 hours and adjust the vinegar and salt before serving.

dishes.description: Fried dough rolled in cinnamon sugar, with a thick hot chocolate for dunking. Serve them the minute they are done.
dishes.name: Churros with Chocolate
steps: Boil the water, butter, and salt, stir in the flour, and beat into a stiff dough.
Pipe or spoon lengths of dough into hot oil and fry until deep golden.
Roll in cinnamon sugar.
Warm the chocolate with the cream into a thick sauce and serve alongside for dunking.

dishes.description: Bacon and Gruyere in a silky egg custard, in a crisp crust. Good warm or at room temperature, for brunch or dinner.
dishes.name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Heat the oven to 375 F and fit the crust into a pie dish.
Crisp the bacon and scatter it in the crust with the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, cream, and nutmeg, pour over, and bake about 40 minutes until just set.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

dishes.description: Tuna, potatoes, green beans, eggs, and olives in a mustard vinaigrette. A composed salad that eats like a meal.
dishes.name: Salade Nicoise
steps: Boil the potatoes and beans until tender and hard-boil the eggs.
Whisk the oil, mustard, and vinegar into a vinaigrette.
Arrange everything over the lettuce and spoon the dressing over at serving time.

dishes.description: Cabbage leaves wrapped around beef and rice, baked in tomato sauce until everything softens together. Sour cream at the table.
dishes.name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves until pliable.
Mix the beef, rice, onion, garlic, and paprika and roll into the leaves.
Pack into a baking dish, cover with tomato sauce, and bake at 350 F for about 1 hour.
Serve with sour cream.

dishes.description: Small buckwheat pancakes topped with smoked salmon, sour cream, and dill. Two bites each, gone in minutes.
dishes.name: Blini with Smoked Salmon
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs, and butter into a batter and rest 15 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in a hot pan, about 1 minute per side.
Top each with sour cream, a fold of salmon, and dill, with lemon on the side.

dishes.description: Beef skewers coated in a spicy ground peanut rub and grilled until the edges char. Served with onion and cucumber to cool the heat.
dishes.name: Suya Skewers
steps: Toss the beef with the ground peanuts, spice blend, oil, and salt and rest at least 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred at the edges, about 8 to 12 minutes.
Serve with the sliced onion.

dishes.description: Golden fried dough balls with nutmeg, crisp outside and pillowy inside. Eaten by the handful, warm.
dishes.name: Puff Puff
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, yeast, nutmeg, and salt with the warm water into a sticky batter.
Cover and rise 1 hour, until bubbly.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry, turning, until deep golden.
Drain and serve warm.

dishes.description: Crisp fried triangles filled with spiced lentils, onion, and jalapeno. The Ethiopian cousin of the samosa, seasoned its own way.

ingredients.item: Sambusa wrappers or spring roll wrappers

dishes.name: Sambusa
steps: Cook the onion, garlic, ginger, and jalapeno until soft, then stir in the lentils and spices and cool.
Fill each wrapper with a spoonful and fold into triangles, sealing with water.
Fry until crisp and golden.

dishes.description: Chicken braised in a berbere-spiced onion sauce with hard-boiled eggs, the Ethiopian celebratory stew. Made for tearing injera.
dishes.name: Doro Wat
steps: Cook the onions slowly, without oil, until deep and sweet, then add the butter.
Stir in the berbere, garlic, and ginger, then the broth and chicken.
Braise 35 to 40 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Add the peeled eggs and lemon and simmer 5 minutes more.

dishes.description: Fluffy couscous with chickpeas, carrots, and zucchini in ras el hanout, with golden raisins for sweetness. A fast, filling side.
dishes.name: Vegetable Couscous
steps: Soften the onion, carrots, and zucchini in the oil with the spices.
Add the broth and chickpeas and simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the couscous, cover off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff with the raisins and herbs.

dishes.description: A Moroccan tomato soup with lentils, chickpeas, and a lot of fresh herbs, lightly thickened and deeply spiced. Traditionally how the fast is broken.
dishes.name: Harira
steps: Simmer the lentils in the broth until nearly tender.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, onion, celery, and spices and simmer 20 minutes.
Whisk the flour with water, stir in to lightly thicken, and finish with the herbs.

dishes.description: Brazilian chocolate truffles made from condensed milk and cocoa, rolled in sprinkles. Two ingredients of work, a party of a result.
dishes.name: Brigadeiros
steps: Cook the condensed milk, cocoa, butter, and salt, stirring constantly, until it thickens and pulls from the pan, about 10 minutes.
Chill until firm.
Roll into small balls with buttered hands and coat in sprinkles.

dishes.description: Firm white fish cured in lime juice with red onion, cilantro, and chile, served with sweet potato and corn. Make it last and eat it first.
dishes.name: Ceviche
steps: Toss the fish with the lime juice and salt and rest 15 to 20 minutes, until opaque at the edges.
Drain off a little of the lime and fold in the onion, jalapeno, and cilantro.
Serve cold with the sweet potato and corn.

dishes.description: Boiled potatoes under a creamy aji amarillo cheese sauce, with eggs, olives, and lettuce. A Peruvian classic starter that works as a side.
dishes.name: Papa a la Huancaina
steps: Blend the cheese, milk, aji paste, crackers, garlic, and oil into a smooth sauce.
Slice the warm potatoes over the lettuce.
Spoon the sauce over and top with halved eggs and olives.

dishes.description: Rice simmered with kidney beans, coconut milk, thyme, and a whole pepper that lends aroma without fire. The Jamaican Sunday side.
dishes.name: Rice and Peas
steps: Combine the beans, coconut milk, garlic, green onions, thyme, and whole jalapeno with water and bring to a boil.
Stir in the rice, cover, and cook on low for about 25 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes, remove the pepper and thyme, and fluff.

dishes.description: A buttery Bundt cake soaked in rum syrup. Contains alcohol, and it does not all bake off, so it should be labeled at the table.
dishes.name: Rum Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 325 F and bake the batter in a Bundt pan for about 45 minutes.
Simmer the remaining sugar, butter, and rum into a syrup.
Poke the warm cake and pour the syrup over slowly until it all soaks in.
Rest at least 2 hours before slicing.

dishes.description: Sweet baked egg noodles with cottage cheese, sour cream, and cinnamon. Comfort food that slices like a casserole.
dishes.name: Noodle Kugel
steps: Heat the oven to 350 F and boil the noodles until just tender.
Whisk the eggs, cottage cheese, sour cream, sugar, butter, and vanilla and fold in the noodles and raisins.
Bake about 45 minutes until set and golden on top.

dishes.description: Small crescent cookies of cream cheese dough rolled around apricot jam, walnuts, and cinnamon. Two bites, no crumbs spared.
dishes.name: Rugelach
steps: Beat the butter and cream cheese, add the flour and salt, and chill the dough at least 1 hour.
Roll into circles, spread with jam, and scatter the walnuts and cinnamon sugar.
Cut into wedges, roll up into crescents, and bake at 350 F for about 20 minutes until golden.

dishes.description: Salmon cured at home with salt, sugar, pepper, and dill, sliced thin with a sweet mustard dill sauce and crispbread. Plan two days ahead.
dishes.name: Gravlax with Mustard-Dill Sauce
steps: Rub the salmon with the salt, sugar, and pepper, cover with dill, wrap tightly, and weight it in the fridge for 48 hours.
Brush off the cure and slice the salmon very thin on a bias.
Whisk the mustard and honey with chopped dill for the sauce.
Serve on crispbread with sauce and lemon.

dishes.description: A warm date sponge drenched in toffee sauce. The British pub dessert that ends arguments about what to bring.
dishes.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
steps: Soak the dates in the boiling water with the soda and let stand 10 minutes.
Cream the butter and most of the sugar, beat in the eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour and the date mixture.
Bake at 350 F for about 30 minutes until springy.
Simmer the cream with the remaining sugar into a toffee sauce and pour over the warm cake.

dishes.description: Collards simmered low with a smoked turkey leg, onion, and a splash of vinegar until silky. The pot liquor is half the point.
dishes.name: Collard Greens with Smoked Turkey
steps: Simmer the turkey leg in the broth for 20 minutes to make a smoky base.
Add the collards, onion, and garlic and simmer about 45 minutes, until silky and tender.
Shred the turkey meat back in and finish with vinegar and pepper flakes.

dishes.description: Golden, tender cornbread with crisp edges, baked in a hot skillet. Slice it thick and serve it warm.
dishes.name: Buttermilk Cornbread
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F with a cast iron skillet inside.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the buttermilk, eggs, and butter just until combined.
Pour into the hot skillet and bake about 25 minutes until golden and pulling from the sides.

note: Catalog for the potluck app: 155 dishes across 25 cuisines, plus 8 supply items. 17 dishes are credited to Joe and 54 are original creations written for this catalog to fill cuisine and course gaps; the rest are classics anyone can claim. Macros are estimated per serving, calculated from the ingredient lists against standard USDA-style values, and labeled estimated in the app. A test verifies calories are within 15 percent of 4x protein + 4x carbs + 9x fat for every dish. The four 2024 Friendsgiving signup rows (Howard rice noodles, Joe salmon, Valerie stuffing, Gardner seltzers) are sample signups, not catalog claims; the dishes here are classics anyone can claim. Recipes are written in our own words from standard preparations.

supplies.name: Ice (2 bags)
supplies.description: Bags of ice for drinks and coolers.

supplies.name: Plates and napkins
supplies.description: Sturdy plates and napkins for the whole table.

supplies.name: Cups
supplies.description: Cups for drinks, hot and cold.

supplies.name: Forks, knives, and spoons
supplies.description: A full set of cutlery for every guest.

supplies.name: Serving spoons and tongs
supplies.description: Serving utensils so every dish has its own.

supplies.name: Foil and plastic wrap
supplies.description: For covering dishes and sending leftovers home.

supplies.name: Cooler
supplies.description: A large cooler for drinks and ice.

supplies.name: Trash and recycling bags
supplies.description: Bags for cleanup at the end of the night.
